replica.hero: Photography, film and studio space that hold their quality for a lifetime.
services: Studio space by the half hour
replica.about: DarlMac Impression is a Nigerian photography studio led by Macauley Nseh, working out of Uyo, Lagos and Abuja. Seven years in, more than 300 projects delivered, and a 5.0 rating from our clients.
replica.tagline: Photography and film from Uyo, Lagos and Abuja.

studio.tagline: Photography, film and studio space in Uyo, Lagos and Abuja.

founder.name: Macauley Nseh
founder.bio: Seven years behind the lens, over 300 projects, and a studio built on one promise: images that still feel right years later.

services.name: Portraits
services.blurb: Individual, couple and family sessions, indoors or outdoors, across Uyo, Lagos and Abuja.

services.name: Weddings
services.blurb: From court marriage and introduction ceremonies to the full DMI signature experience.

services.name: Videography
services.blurb: Trailers, reels and full-length films for weddings, events and brands.

services.name: Events
services.blurb: Birthdays, graduations, corporate and brand shoots, covered end to end.

services.name: Studio Space
services.blurb: Backdrop and content space, rented by the half hour, in our Uyo studio.

services.name: DMI Academy
services.blurb: A three-month photography school in Uyo, training the next set of Nigerian photographers.
